definitions.explanation: Physical currency as opposed to credit.

examples.japanese: {現金|げんきん}で{払|はら}います。
{現金|げんきん}を{持|も}っていない。
examples.english: I don't have cash on me.

examples.japanese: {現金|げんきん}{払|ばら}いのみ

notes:
{現金|げんきん} refers to physical cash.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {現金|げんきん}で{払|はら}う (to pay in cash)
- {現金|げんきん}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す (to withdraw cash)

CONTRAST:
- {現金|げんきん} (cash)
- クレジットカード (credit card)
- 電子{マネー|まねー} (electronic money)
